propositions: The documentation link checker must validate inline Markdown links and images against a deterministic maintained-documentation boundary that includes root files and specific subdirectories while excluding .joe-janitor, .rebar/prompts, and other specified paths.

Relative link targets must resolve from their source directory to any location within the repository; missing targets and targets that escape the repository must each produce a deterministic finding with source path, line number, raw target, normalized path, and failure reason.

The checker must retain existing top-level docs index-membership behavior as a separate rule and replace the duplicate outbound-link parser in test_all_docs_relative_links_resolve with a unified checker API.
Scheme-qualified targets, fragment-only targets, fenced code blocks, and inline code spans must be excluded from validation; query strings and fragments must be stripped before file resolution.
The maintained source and parser boundary must be documented in docs/documentation-policy.md with explicit source patterns, exclusions, and parser behavior.
Excluded Markdown sources may remain valid link targets when referenced from included sources.
